sections.content: Container queries style elements based on their PARENT's size, not the viewport — finally solving "component that adapts to its slot".
Declare containment on a wrapper (container-type: inline-size), then use @container (min-width: 400px) rules inside. Perfect for cards in sidebars vs main columns.
Key points: need containment context, units cqw/cqh/cqi express container-relative sizes, and support is now broad in modern browsers.
